options.text: It contains fewer pastries in total.
options.whyZh: 四加二仍是六個，總數未減。

options.text: All of the pastries will be plain.
options.whyZh: 只有兩個改原味，還有四個杏仁口味。

options.text: It adds two pastries to the original six.
options.zh: 在原本六個之外再加兩個。
options.whyZh: 原味替換掉兩個，不是加訂。

options.text: The quantity stays the same, but the mix changes.
options.zh: 總數維持不變，但口味組合改了。
options.whyZh: 原訂六個杏仁；改為四個杏仁、兩個原味，所以總數仍是六個。

explanationZh: 原訂六個杏仁；改為四個杏仁、兩個原味，所以總數仍是六個。
evidence: I ordered six almond pastries for festival pickup. Can I switch two to plain? My younger sister prefers plain. / Sure. Four almond, two plain. They scan your receipt at pickup, so keep the original code.
